title: Injective tangent map gives surjective cotangent map
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism locally of finite type between schemes over a field $k$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $x\in X$ and $y=f(x)$ be closed points with residue fields equal to $k$. If the induced map on tangent spaces $T_{X/k,x}\to T_{Y/k,y}$ [def-sc-scheme-tangent-space] is injective, then the induced local-ring map gives a surjection $\mathfrak m_y/\mathfrak m_y^2\to\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2$ on cotangent spaces. (Stacks Project, Varieties, Tag 0B2E.)

source.place: Tag 0B2E, lemma-tangent-space-rational-point (with S = Spec k, T_{X/k,x} = Hom_k(m_x/m_x^2, k)); the dual of a linear map is injective iff the map is surjective

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-rational-tangent-cotangent-duality] to $f$ at $x$ and $y$. Because both residue fields are $k$, its canonical identifications make the given tangent map the dual of the local-ring map $u:\mathfrak m_y/\mathfrak m_y^2\to\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2$.

source.place: Tag 0B2E, lemma-tangent-space-rational-point; Tag 0B2C, dual-number definition and functoriality

proof.text: The hypothesis says that $u^*$ is injective under the identifications of step 1. Apply [lem-sc-dual-map-injective-iff-surjective] to the $k$-linear map $u$; it follows that $u$ is surjective, as required.

lean.statement: theorem cotangent_surjective_of_tangent_injective (k : Type u) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (pX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (pY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (hf : f ≫ pY = pX) (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) (hy : IsClosed ({f x} : Set Y)) (hκx : Function.Bijective (pX.residueFieldMap x).hom) (hκy : Function.Bijective (pY.residueFieldMap (f x)).hom) (hdf : ∃ he : Function.Bijective (f.residueFieldMap x).hom, Function.Injective (schemeTangentMap k X Y pX pY f hf x he)) : Function.Surjective (Ideal.mapCotangent (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (f.stalkMap x).hom.toIntAlgHom (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp (IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_le (f.stalkMap x).hom)) : IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) →ₗ[ℤ] IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace (X.presheaf.stalk x))
